body.x: AMARYLLO(www.amaryllo.eu) announced 'iCam HD'at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

It is the world's first wireless IP Camera featuring connected to Skype Technology. All iCam HD cameras come with built-in speaker, so users can receive clear detail that users expect from Skype. In addition to 1280x720 high definition video recording, the lens have a viewing angle of 100 degrees, together with the remote pan and tilt control, users have a 360 degree view of the surrounding area. The night vision feature of the iCam HD can capture video in complete darkness more 5 meters away. Our microchips use the latest H.264 video encoders that ensure minimal delay between the camera and your device. As specified by Skype, the lag time while streaming video must never exceed 0.5 seconds. So you can be sure that what you are seeing is 'real time'.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
